input.body: We are writing to request a review of a $27.40 deduction on order DD-48290, dated 2026-11-08, which was applied with the reason "missing item" (Protein Bowl). The order ticket for DD-48290 lists a Fruit Bowl and a Green Smoothie, and does not list a Protein Bowl [DD-48290:ticket_omits_item]. Our records also show the order was ready at 17:35 and picked up at 17:39, four minutes later [DD-48290:pickup_handoff]. We understand the ticket shows how the order was prepared and does not show the contents of the bag. Based on the ticket, the item named in the deduction was not part of this order as it was prepared. We respectfully ask that the deduction be reviewed and reversed. Thank you for your time and consideration.
